title: When the Trail Wakes
author: Quentin Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Yarrow, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
